source: CSB Report 2016-02-I-MS: Executive Summary (p.11), Sections 4.1-4.3 (p.21-26, withheld or stripped), 6.4 (p.48), Recommendations R1-R4 (p.55). Withheld or stripped.
question: Initial failure, mechanism and prevention for the 2016 Pascagoula BAHX rupture.

items.engineers: First loss of containment was the ACSR losing core integrity just before 11:21 p.m.: partial loss of the north cap sheet with outer layers; the B-inlet header breaches were consequences of the fire (ACSR metal sensors and both-pass dP failed first).
leak_phrases: partial loss of the north cap sheet was the most likely initial failure point

items.engineers: Damage mechanism was accumulated thermal fatigue (not overpressure from process upset, ice, thermal shock that night, corrosion or mercury); the exchanger had repeatedly exceeded ROC guidance (1.8 F/min cyclic, 3.6 F/min start-up/shutdown) over its 17-year life, with leaks in 2007, 2011, 2014, 2015.
leak_phrases: probable cause of this incident was the failure of a brazed aluminum heat exchanger (BAHX) due to thermal fatigue

items.engineers: Most likely scenario: the September 2015 repair blocked the outer layers; their vent holes were later welded closed; process fluid leaked into blocked layer 98 through a thermal fatigue crack from active layer 97; when the unit was warmed during the NGL shutdown (hot oil burner lit) the trapped fluid expanded (CSB estimate up to ~705 psig, below the 1,200 psig MAWP) and the fatigue-weakened braze joints failed, so the cap sheet and blocked layers separated from the core.
leak_phrases: maximum calculated pressure would be 705 psig

items.engineers: Layers blocked off during interpass leak repair must be safely vented (not welded shut); guidance should explain the consequences when they are not.
leak_phrases: need to safely vent layers that have been blocked off

items.engineers: Leak-before-break / repair-on-leak is not sufficient: operators must assess and manage the risk of sudden catastrophic BAHX rupture from accumulated thermal fatigue (PHA downgraded it to minor leaks and repair cost); use the hierarchy of controls, consider replacement or inherently safer exchangers, and develop criteria for preemptive replacement.
leak_phrases: reliance on a leak-before-failure assumption is not sufficient
assess and manage the risk of sudden and catastrophic BAHX rupture

items.engineers: Monitor stream temperature rates of change (metal side-bar sensors read ~10x lower ROC and the alarm was set at 14.25 F/min), clarify sensor placement, keep lifetime operating data, and share BAHX operating data industry-wide to predict service life.
leak_phrases: optimal placement of BAHX temperature and pressure sensors
Develop a database for operators to submit BAHX operational data
